SEARCH
Package scene

Class JsonScene

java.lang.Object
scene.JsonScene
public class JsonScene extends Object
The JsonScene class provides functionality to import 3D scenes from JSON files. It parses scene definitions including geometries, materials, lights and other properties, converting them into Scene objects that can be rendered by the ray tracing engine.

    • importScene

      public static Scene importScene(String path) throws IOException, org.json.simple.parser.ParseException
      Imports a scene from a JSON file. Reads the file at the given path, parses the JSON structure, and constructs a Scene object with all defined properties, geometries, and light sources.
      Throws:
      IOException
      org.json.simple.parser.ParseException

    • parseLights

      private static List<LightSource> parseLights(org.json.simple.JSONArray lights)
      Parses an array of light source definitions from JSON. Identifies the type of each light (point, directional, or spot) and delegates to the appropriate parsing method.

    • parseSpotLight

      private static LightSource parseSpotLight(org.json.simple.JSONObject lightObj)
      Parses a spot light from a JSON object. Creates a SpotLight with the specified intensity, position, and direction, and applies optional attenuation factors and narrow beam settings if defined.
